title: Why I Sold The Trade Desk Stock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: He sold one-third of his TTD position (bought ~$44, sold ~$13, a massive loss) for tax-loss harvesting and is leaning toward selling the remaining two-thirds (cost basis ~$19-20) rather than holding. The trigger: revenue collapsed from 11.8% growth (March quarter) to 3% (June quarter), with Wall Street forecasting -12% in September and -18% in December, and no growth until 2.1% in September 2027. He blames Amazon's 1-5% fees destroying the 15-20% take-rate model, and management's counterarguments haven't convinced investors. He downgraded TTD from one of his best-buy picks at the start of 2026 to medium conviction and now to LOW conviction; fair value $22 (revised lower repeatedly, currently 12.5x forward PE). He admits TTD is his worst-performing 2026 estimate and keeps surprising to the downside. Verdict: SELL (he personally sold; remaining position tenuous). Other tickers: AMZN, AVGO, MU mentioned in passing as AI names whose fair values keep rising.

calls.thesis: Sold 1/3 for tax-loss harvesting and is leaning toward selling the rest — revenue collapsed from 11.8% to 3% growth, Wall Street forecasts -12%/-18% declines ahead, and he keeps revising estimates lower each quarter.
calls.base_case: Fair value $22 vs ~$13 looks undervalued, but the trend line is 'so awful' he expects to revise lower again; downgraded to low conviction (was medium).
calls.bull_case: Forward PE ~12.5 prices in zero growth; digital ad market still grows double digits if Trade Desk just holds share.
calls.bear_case: Amazon's 1-5% fees vs Trade Desk's 15-20% take rate; revenue not expected to grow again until Sep 2027 (+2.1%).
